current.metadata_title: Fine-scale spatial population genomics of Plasmodium falciparum across Ghana's agro-ecological zones (revised)
visible_first_paragraphs: Population differentiation and antimalarial resistance-marker frequencies in Plasmodium falciparum across the agro-ecological zones of Ghana, 2009-2021
[AUTHOR NAMES AND AFFILIATIONS TO BE SUPPLIED]

table_caption_order.caption: Table 1 Composition of the analysis set, with the sequencing study, administrative region and collection period that accompany each agro-ecological zone. Zone is very nearly a relabelling of region and study: three of the four zones draw on a single administrative region, and one on a single study. The final column is measured on the pre-filter quality-control cohort of 4,905 isolates, not on the analysis set: every analysed isolate satisfies Fws ≥ 0.95 by construction, so its polyclonal fraction is zero. QC-cohort denominators are given in the column.
Table 2 Pairwise Hudson FST between agro-ecological zones on 3,916 SNPs and 1,900 isolates, with block-jackknife 95% confidence intervals. Five of the six intervals exclude zero.
Table 4 Threshold sensitivity of the two headline spatial results. The maximum pairwise FST is stable across all six scenarios; the distance effect clears p = 0.05 in only two of them.

Table 3 Resistance-marker frequencies overall and by agro-ecological zone. Denominators are isolates called at that codon or, for haplotypes, isolates called at every constituent codon. The chi-square column tests heterogeneity across the four zones.
